data.title: 八重神子 · 鸣神大社的晨间洒扫
data.description: 清晨的参道，她穿着宫司正装手持御币缓步而行，狐耳在晨雾里微动；向石阶上的神樱微微颔首——端庄的一面只在无人的清晨营业。
data.action: 清晨的参道，她穿着宫司正装手持御币缓步而行，狐耳在晨雾里微动
data.promptProse: Yae Miko advances slowly along the shrine approach, neatly secured red-and-white robes surrounding the ceremonial paper wand held before her. Her violet eyes lift toward the Sacred Sakura and fox ears stir in the breeze. Stone steps recede behind the medium view beneath pale blossoms and dawn mist. Early light grazes the wand's folded paper and her pink hair, while the sheltered side of her robes retains cool shade.
